name: awesome-black-friday-ai-deals (tubeagentkit)
accepts: AI tools, developer tools and APIs, creator and design tools, productivity software. Run by the team behind GetYouTubeTranscript, whose own entry is in the list.
how_to_submit: Issue form 'Submit a deal' (title prefix 'Deal: ', required: product name, URL, category, one-sentence description, deal, end date, vendor source link; optional code and an 'I work on or for this product' box), or a pull request adding one object to data/deals.json and running python3 scripts/build_readme.py, with the regenerated README committed. Do not edit the README tables by hand.
entry_format: JSON object with name, url, category, description, deal, code (null when none), ends (YYYY-MM-DD or 'not stated'), source_url, verified_on, lifetime. The build script sorts rows alphabetically.
rules: Links with affiliate, referral or tracking parameters are rejected by the CI check.

Pull request template boxes: added one object to data/deals.json; ran the build script and committed the README; links have no tracking parameters. It also asks for the product, the source page and your affiliation.
The README asks for a star 'to find it again next November'. That is a request, not a condition.
status_note: Created 15 Nov 2026 with one commit and no commits since. On 20 Nov 2026: 0 pull requests merged, 6 open, 6 submission issues open and unanswered.
